name: Balanced score of a response against its quality profile
purpose: One balanced score for each quality profile, with the weights and targets of the profile fixed before any method is scored.
record: A quality profile is a named set of criteria with weights and target values. A profile change is a new version of the metric, so scores under different profiles are never mixed. The leaderboard compares response-quality methods under each profile, the default profile first. The default profile draws on public response-quality recommendations and evaluations (see the Response Quality area of the registry). Draft: no cases or runs exist yet.
disadvantages: A draft: it names what to measure, and no cases are written yet.
